methods_quotes.q: Global or regional coverage = a weighted sum of WHO/UNICEF estimates of national coverage (WUENIC) by target population
WHO and UNICEF review reported coverage data and surveys to generate country-specific coverage estimates.
Timely HepB-BD is defined as a dose of HepB given within 24 hours of birth.
